title: Kalshi Says It Does Not Operate Like a Sports Book

Kalshi and other prediction markets are coming under more pressure from multiple states and regulators. New York City and New York State are both investigating the exchange.

title: Stocks Rise Ahead of More Data; US Hits China with 100% Tariffs on Drones | Bloomberg Brief 08/14/26
summary: US equity futures waver after stocks notched a fresh record high ahead of retail sales and consumer sentiment data. Oil climbs as Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says the US will announce unprecedented plans for Iran's "economic isolation" next week. The Trump administration imposes levies of as much as 100% on imported drones and components, further decoupling from drone supply chains with China. OpenAI is said to be on track to generate annualized revenue of more than $40 billion. Stephanie Guild, CIO of Robinhood, looks ahead to more data following the latest signs of cooling inflation. (Source: Bloomberg)
